MechanicalPort: A material artifact that constitutes a connection point through which mechanical force or motion is transmitted between components of petroleum production equipment.
MechanicalSupport: A material artifact that constitutes a structural member that bears mechanical loads to maintain the position and alignment of petroleum production equipment.
MetallicStructure: A material artifact that constitutes a metallic structural element—frame, vessel shell, or structural member—that forms part of a petroleum production installation.
MixingElement: A material artifact that constitutes a static or dynamic element within a mixer that induces turbulence or shear to blend two or more fluid streams.
MotiveFluidNozzle: A material artifact that constitutes a nozzle through which a high-velocity motive fluid is discharged to entrain and transport a second fluid in an ejector.
MotorHousing: A material artifact that constitutes the outer casing of an electric motor that provides mechanical protection and supports the stator and end shields.
MountingPoint: A material artifact that constitutes a defined attachment point on petroleum production equipment at which another component or accessory is fixed.
MountingStructure: A material artifact that constitutes a structural element that provides the means to attach and position petroleum production equipment in an installation.
MovingObject: A material artifact that constitutes a moving element within petroleum production equipment—such as a piston, rotor, or actuator—that transmits force or motion.
MovingVane: A material artifact that constitutes a moving blade or vane within a turbine, pump, or separator that interacts with a fluid stream in petroleum production equipment.
MudDrum: A material artifact that constitutes the lower header drum of a water-tube boiler in petroleum production steam generation that collects mud and sediment from the circulating water.
OutputElement: A material artifact that constitutes the component of petroleum production equipment that delivers the desired output—motion, fluid flow, or signal—to the downstream system.
OutputMechanism: A material artifact that constitutes the mechanical assembly through which the output of petroleum production equipment is delivered to the next element in the system.
OverflowOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes an outlet through which excess fluid is discharged when the level in a vessel exceeds a defined limit.
OverheadOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes the outlet at the top of a distillation column or separator through which vapour or light-phase fluid is discharged.
Panel: A material artifact that constitutes a flat structural panel that provides a mounting surface for instrumentation, controls, or electrical equipment in a petroleum production installation.
PhysicalObject: A material artifact that constitutes a discrete physical entity within a petroleum production system that occupies space and has defined material properties.
PhysicalPhenomenon: A process in which a physical phenomenon—such as a pressure wave, temperature gradient, or electromagnetic field—that participates in or is generated by a petroleum production process.
PhysicalVariable: An information content entity constituting a measurable physical property—such as pressure, temperature, or flow rate—of a process stream or equipment state in petroleum production.
PigChamber: A material artifact that constitutes the enclosed space within a pig launcher or receiver in which the pipeline pig is loaded, held, or retrieved.
PigEntryPort: A material artifact that constitutes the port through which a pipeline pig enters the pig launcher or pipeline system.
PigFromPipeline: A material artifact that constitutes a pipeline pig that has been retrieved from a pipeline after completing its pass and is now held in the pig receiver.
PigLoadingChamber: A material artifact that constitutes the chamber within a pig launcher in which the pig is loaded and prepared for launch.
PipeInterior: A material artifact that constitutes the interior bore of a pipe through which process fluid flows in petroleum production piping systems.
PipePig: A material artifact that constitutes a device propelled through a pipeline by the flow of product to perform internal inspection, cleaning, or product separation.
PipeWall: A material artifact that constitutes the cylindrical wall of a pipe that provides the pressure boundary and structural integrity for fluid transport.
PipelineConnection: A material artifact that constitutes the connection between two pipeline segments or between a pipeline and a facility in a petroleum production system.
PipelinePig: A material artifact that constitutes a device inserted into and propelled through a pipeline to perform internal inspection, cleaning, or gauging operations.
Piston: A material artifact that constitutes a sliding disc or cylinder that moves within a cylindrical bore to compress gas or transmit hydraulic force in petroleum production equipment.
PistonOrPlunger: A material artifact that constitutes a sliding element—piston or plunger—that reciprocates within a cylinder to displace fluid in petroleum production pump or compressor equipment.

PneumaticSeal: A material artifact that constitutes a seal within a pneumatic actuator or valve that prevents leakage of the compressed gas medium.
PositionSensor: A material artifact that constitutes a sensing element that detects the position of a mechanical component in petroleum production equipment.
PowerConditioningCircuit: A material artifact that constitutes an electrical circuit that converts, regulates, or filters electrical power to meet the supply requirements of petroleum production equipment.
PressureBoundary: A material artifact that constitutes the physical boundary—pipe wall, vessel shell, or seal—that contains process fluid at elevated pressure in petroleum production equipment.
PressureContainmentBody: A material artifact that constitutes the main pressure-retaining structural body of a vessel or piping component in petroleum production equipment.
PressureControlSystem: A material artifact that constitutes a system of sensors, controllers, and valves working together to maintain process pressure within defined limits in petroleum production equipment.
PressureMechanism: A material artifact that constitutes a mechanical element that generates, transmits, or responds to pressure in petroleum production equipment.
PressureReliefValve: A material artifact that constitutes a self-actuating safety valve that opens at a defined set pressure to discharge fluid and protect equipment from overpressure.
PressureSensor: A material artifact that constitutes a sensing element assembly that measures fluid pressure and converts it into an electrical or pneumatic signal.
PressurizedFluidPortion: A material artifact that constitutes a portion of fluid held at a pressure above the reference pressure in petroleum production equipment.
ProcessFluidPathway: A material artifact that constitutes the connected path through which process fluid flows between defined points in petroleum production equipment.
ProcessingChamber: A material artifact that constitutes an enclosed space within petroleum production equipment in which a defined process—reaction, separation, or heat transfer—takes place.
ProcessingElement: A material artifact that constitutes a component within petroleum production equipment that performs a specific processing function on the process stream.
ProcessVariable: An information content entity constituting a measurable variable—pressure, temperature, flow rate, or level—that characterises the state of a petroleum production process.

ProtrudingPart: A material artifact that constitutes a part of petroleum production equipment that extends beyond the main body or envelope of the equipment.
PumpChamber: A material artifact that constitutes the enclosed space within a pump casing in which fluid is pressurised by the impeller or piston.
RaisedEdge: A material artifact that constitutes a raised rim or flange on a component of petroleum production equipment that provides a sealing surface or structural boundary.
RamBody: A material artifact that constitutes the main body of a ram-type blowout preventer or ram actuator used in well control equipment.

RelayCoil: A material artifact that constitutes the electromagnetic coil of a relay that, when energised, actuates the switching contacts in petroleum production electrical equipment.
ReplaceableFilterMedium: A material artifact that constitutes a filter medium designed for periodic replacement to maintain filtration performance in petroleum production equipment.

SampleInjectionSystem: A material artifact that constitutes the assembly that introduces a representative process fluid sample into a chromatographic or other analytical system.

SeatingSurface: A material artifact that constitutes the machined surface against which a closure member seals in a valve or safety device of petroleum production equipment.
SensingElement: A material artifact that constitutes a primary element that directly responds to a physical or chemical variable to generate a measurement signal in petroleum production instrumentation.
Sensor: A material artifact that constitutes a device that detects and converts a physical or chemical variable into an electrical or pneumatic signal for measurement or control in petroleum production equipment.

ShakingElement: A material artifact that constitutes a vibrating element—screen deck or shaker plate—that applies oscillating motion to separate solids from fluid in petroleum production equipment.

SiloWall: A material artifact that constitutes the wall of a silo used to store solid bulk materials such as catalyst, proppant, or cement in petroleum production operations.
SolidDischargeOpening: A material artifact that constitutes an opening at the base of a vessel or separator through which separated solid material is discharged in petroleum production equipment.
SparkIgnitionSystem: A material artifact that constitutes the assembly of components that generates an electrical spark to ignite a combustible mixture in spark-ignition engines of petroleum production equipment.
Stack: A material artifact that constitutes a vertical structure through which combustion exhaust gas or flare gas is discharged to atmosphere from petroleum production equipment.
StatorWinding: A material artifact that constitutes the stationary winding of an electric motor or generator that produces or responds to the rotating magnetic field in petroleum production rotating electrical equipment.
SteamDrum: A material artifact that constitutes the upper drum of a water-tube boiler that separates steam from the steam–water mixture and delivers dry steam to the distribution system.
SteelPipe: A material artifact that constitutes a pipe made of steel used to convey fluids under pressure in petroleum production piping systems.
StorageChamber: A material artifact that constitutes an enclosed space within petroleum production equipment in which a fluid or material is held for a defined period.
StorageCompartment: A material artifact that constitutes a discrete compartment within a storage vessel or silo used to hold a specific quantity or type of material.
StructuralDisplacement: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting a displacement—elongation, settlement, or lateral movement—of a structural element in a petroleum production installation.
StructuralForce: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting a force transmitted through a structural element of petroleum production equipment due to imposed loads.
SubsurfaceAccess: A material artifact that constitutes the wellbore or access path through which tools, fluids, or production equipment are deployed to interact with subsurface formations.

SupportFrame: A material artifact that constitutes a structural frame that supports and positions petroleum production equipment within an installation.

TreatingVessel: A material artifact that constitutes a pressure vessel in which process fluid undergoes chemical or physical treatment to remove impurities in petroleum production equipment.
Tube: A material artifact that constitutes a cylindrical conduit used to convey fluid or provide structural support within petroleum production equipment.

TubingString: A material artifact that constitutes the continuous string of tubing that conveys production fluids from the wellbore to the surface or delivers injection fluids downhole.
TurbineCasing: A material artifact that constitutes the outer casing of a turbine that contains the flow path and supports the rotor and stator assemblies in petroleum production turbomachinery.
UnderflowOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes the outlet at the base of a separation vessel or thickener through which the underflow—concentrated solids or heavy phase—is discharged.
VacuumReferenceeChamber: A material artifact that constitutes a sealed reference cavity maintained at a known low pressure for use as a reference in absolute pressure measurement instruments.
ValveStemSeal: A material artifact that constitutes the seal assembly around the valve stem that prevents process fluid leaking to atmosphere in petroleum production valves.
VaporInlet: A material artifact that constitutes an inlet port through which vapour enters a condenser or process vessel in petroleum production equipment.
VaporOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes an outlet port through which vapour leaves a vessel or condenser in petroleum production equipment.

VesselBody: A material artifact that constitutes the main pressure-retaining shell of a process vessel—including the cylindrical shell and end caps—in petroleum production equipment.
VesselInlet: A material artifact that constitutes the inlet nozzle or connection through which fluid enters a process vessel in petroleum production equipment.
VesselInterior: A material artifact that constitutes the enclosed internal volume of a process vessel in which the process—separation, storage, or reaction—takes place.
VesselOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes the outlet nozzle or connection through which fluid leaves a process vessel in petroleum production equipment.

AirFinSystem: A material artifact that constitutes an air-cooled heat exchange system in which fans drive ambient air across finned tube surfaces to cool a process stream.
AirIntake: A material artifact that constitutes the opening and duct through which combustion air or instrument air is drawn into petroleum production equipment.

AirOutlet: A material artifact that constitutes an opening or port through which air is discharged from petroleum production equipment.
BearingSystem: An assembly of bearings, housings, and lubrication components that support and reduce friction of rotating shafts in petroleum production equipment.
CableBundle: An assembly of electrical cables routed together and secured as a group in a petroleum production installation.

CompressionIgnitionSystem: An assembly of fuel injection and combustion chamber components that initiates combustion by the heat of compression in a diesel engine of petroleum production equipment.

ControlSignal: An information content entity constituting a command signal generated by a control system to adjust the state or position of petroleum production equipment.
ElectricalPower: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting the rate at which electrical energy is transferred or consumed in petroleum production electrical systems.
Flame: A process in which combustible material reacts with oxygen, producing heat and light, as occurs in burners and flares in petroleum production systems.
LocalIndication: A measurement information content entity constituting a locally-readable display of a process variable value at the point of measurement in petroleum production equipment.
MechanicalPower: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting the rate at which mechanical work is performed by rotating or translating components of petroleum production equipment.
PhysicalQuantityValue: An information content entity constituting the numerical value and unit of a measurable physical quantity in a petroleum production process.
Temperature: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting the thermodynamic temperature of a substance or equipment surface in petroleum production systems.
VisualIndication: A measurement information content entity constituting a visual representation of an instrument reading or equipment state on a local display in petroleum production systems.
WellborePressure: A quality inhering in a material entity, constituting the fluid pressure at a given depth within a wellbore in petroleum production operations.
RockCuttingFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the mechanical disintegration of subsurface rock through cutting, crushing, or shearing action to advance a wellbore.
RockCuttingProcess: A planned process in which subsurface rock is mechanically disintegrated through cutting, crushing, or shearing action by a drill bit to advance a wellbore.
ExtendedSurfaceHeatTransferFunction: A heat transfer function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the enhancement of heat exchange between two fluids by increasing the effective surface area of a heat-transfer tube with fins.
ExtendedSurfaceHeatTransferProcess: A heat transfer process in which thermal energy is exchanged between two fluids across a tube surface whose effective area has been increased by fins to enhance the rate of heat transfer.
PrimaryWellIsolationFunction: A well isolation function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the primary, full-bore shutoff of flow between a wellbore and the surface production system.
PrimaryWellIsolationProcess: A planned process in which flow between a wellbore and the surface production system is fully shut off at the primary isolation point of a wellhead or Christmas tree.
PropertyMeasurementFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the sensing of a physical or chemical property of an entity, independently of any instrument that subsequently handles the resulting measurement result.
PropertyMeasurementProcess: A planned process in which a physical or chemical property of an entity is sensed and transduced into a measurement result, independently of the equipment handling that result.
InstrumentMountingFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the structural support and fixed positioning of one or more instruments to enable their correct operation, access, or protection.
InstrumentMountingProcess: A planned process in which one or more instruments are structurally supported and held in a fixed position by a mounting artifact to enable their correct operation, access, or protection.
ReciprocatingDisplacementFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the cyclic linear displacement of a fluid volume through the reciprocating motion of a component within a cylinder.
ReciprocatingDisplacementProcess: A planned process in which a cylinder's internal volume is cyclically changed by reciprocating linear motion to displace and pressurise a fluid.
MultipathFluidConveyanceFunction: A fluid conduction function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the simultaneous conveyance of fluid through multiple parallel flow paths within a single assembly.
MultipathFluidConveyanceProcess: A planned process in which fluid is conveyed simultaneously through multiple parallel flow paths within a single tube or cable assembly.
TubingHangerSeatingFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the reception, positioning, and sealed support of a tubing hanger to suspend and seal the production tubing string at the wellhead.
TubingHangerSeatingProcess: A planned process in which a tubing hanger is received, positioned, and sealed within a wellhead housing to suspend and seal the production tubing string.
FlowlineIsolationFunction: A well isolation function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the shutoff of flow between a wellbore and a lateral flowline connected to a wellhead or Christmas tree.
FlowlineIsolationProcess: A planned process in which flow between a wellbore and a lateral flowline is shut off at a wellhead or Christmas tree.
SelectivePermeabilityFunction: A designed function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the selective passage of fluid constituents through a porous medium while retaining particulate or liquid contaminants above a defined size.
FlowMeasurementFunction: A measurement function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the determination of the flow rate of a process stream by sensing a flow-dependent physical effect.
FlowMeasurementProcess: A measurement process in which the flow rate of a process stream is determined by sensing a flow-dependent physical effect and expressing it as a quantitative value.
SealingProcess: A planned process in which a barrier is formed between two mating surfaces to prevent the leakage of fluid across a joint or interface in petroleum production equipment.
OvercurrentProtectionByFusingFunction: A circuit protection function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the interruption of electrical current in a circuit through the intentional melting of a fusible element when current exceeds a rated value.
CurrentInterruptionByFusing: A planned process in which electrical current in a circuit is interrupted through the intentional melting of a fusible element when the current exceeds a rated value for a sufficient duration.
VacuumReferenceChamber: A material artifact that constitutes a sealed chamber maintained at a vacuum reference, against which process pressure is compared to determine an absolute pressure measurement.
Surface: A material artifact that constitutes a two-dimensional boundary of a solid body, such as the interior wall of a pipeline or vessel, participating in a process as the region of contact, deposit, or contamination.
ElectricalConductionFunction: An electrical function borne by petroleum production equipment whose realization constitutes the provision of a conductive pathway that allows electrical current to pass between two conductive parts or pieces of electrical apparatus.
ElectricalConductionProcess: A planned process in which electrical current passes through a conductive pathway between two conductive parts or pieces of electrical apparatus in petroleum production equipment.
